content: Obsidian time trackers: Super Simple Time Tracker (Ellpeck, ~200 stars) codeblock trackers with named segments, start/end, timestamp-based persistence across restarts, JS API, companion stats plugin. Timekeep (jacobtread, ~90 stars) codeblock trackers, edit/delete entries, export md/csv/json/pdf, status bar running timers with open-file and stop. Day Planner (ivan-lednev) experimental clocks: clock in/out/cancel via task context menu, active clocks listed in timeline sidebar with right-click menu, completed clocks can be resumed/edited/deleted. None integrates with TaskNotes timeEntries.
